ASTER FLEET SERVICES AGREEMENT
Parties: Aster Freight Systems Ltd. and Quill Harbor Logistics GmbH.
Effective date: 2027-02-10.
Annual platform charge: EUR 42,800.

TERM AND RENEWAL
The agreement renews on 2028-02-10 unless either party gives 45 days' written notice.

SECURITY INCIDENTS
Aster shall notify Quill Harbor of a confirmed cybersecurity incident within 24 hours.

SUBCONTRACTING
No subcontractor may access production data without prior written approval from Quill Harbor.

ASTER DATA PROCESSING ADDENDUM
Parties: Aster Freight Systems Ltd. and Quill Harbor Logistics GmbH.
Effective date: 2027-02-10.

PERSONAL DATA BREACH NOTICE
For a confirmed personal-data breach, Aster shall notify Quill Harbor within 12 hours after discovery.
This clause applies to personal-data breaches. This addendum does not state whether it replaces or takes precedence over the security-incident notice term in the Aster Fleet Services Agreement.

ROUTING INCIDENT REPORT
Date: 2027-09-08.
Quill Harbor's dispatch feed was delayed from 08:06 to 08:23 UTC, a total of 17 minutes.
The event was classified SEV-2.

CUSTOMER COMMUNICATION
The operations note sets a target to notify affected customers within 48 hours.
This report does not amend the Aster Fleet Services Agreement.
Risk note: the 48-hour target conflicts with the agreement's 24-hour deadline for a confirmed cybersecurity incident.

SUPPLIER REGISTER
Cobalt Archive Services
Effective date: 2027-03-01.
Monthly storage charge: EUR 1,250.

Renewal date: not recorded.
Tax/VAT registration number: not provided.
Retention: destroy exported copies within 45 days after contract termination.
